lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with internal spacing roughly equidistant within each column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular clusters, forming a grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A small secondary organism (remora) is visible in the water column immediately below the pectoral fin.
